## LAYER 1 — Heritage & Origins

- **40 years as operator**: agro-export (banana, Ecuador — Grupo Agrícola Cañas C.A., 850ha, 9 farms) + mining
- **Sole founder & engineer**: built TACTIK on a mobile device in under 2 months
- **Academic**: IE Business School background
- **Domain**: Latin American institutional and commodity markets, adversarial negotiation environments
- **Origin of TACTIK**: "The tool I always wished I'd had" — 4 decades of consequential decisions with incomplete information, adversarial counterparties, real political cost

## LAYER 2 — Cognitive Style

- **Spiral thinker** — not linear. Vision first → architecture → experiment → validation → expand
- **High research patience**: reads everything available before deciding what to build
- **Category identifier**: always looking for the gap nobody names ("the category Google doesn't own yet")
- **IP-first lens**: in any session, will identify which element has real moat before building features
- **Expands objectives mid-session**: starts with a specific request, discovers the bigger question while executing
- **Signature pattern**: pauses deliberately when saying something important ("lo voy a decir muy pausadamente") — these moments contain the session's core IP

---

## LAYER 3 — Communication Patterns

- **Primary language**: Spanish in strategic and creative contexts; English for institutional/technical communication
- **Natural code-switching**: mixes both in real-time without loss of precision
- **Deliberate pacing**: speaks slowly when conveying core ideas — compression, not rambling
- **Precision over eloquence**: values exact language over polished language
- **Prefers showing over explaining**: "haz el experimento aquí mismo" over "dime cómo funcionaría"

## LAYER 4 — Decision Framework (Santiago Doctrine v1.0.0)

Canonical reference: `supabase/functions/_shared/doctrine.ts` in Lovable project `bfe41ad4`

| Principle | Application |
|---|---|
| **Relational Intent (master-gate)** | Evaluates the real motive behind any request or partnership before responding |
| **Probe-Stall Detection** | Recognizes when a counterpart is buying time vs. genuinely engaging |
| **Subject-Axis** | Keeps the real subject of analysis stable even when conversation shifts |
| **Theater vs. Belief** | Distinguishes performed positions from genuine convictions |
| **Governance** | Applies institutional logic (not individual logic) to corporate counterparts |
| **Magnitude** | Assesses consequence scale before committing any resource |

**Rule**: "Give before you ask." Value demonstration precedes any ask — always.

## SESSION LEDGER (append-only)

### Session 001 — 2026-06-23 · Claude Code
**Branch**: `claude/tactik-new-brief-category-h7trp4`
**Duration**: ~4 hours
**PCG Score**: 87/100

**What was decided:**
- The Brief system is the core IP — not the simulation engine, not the DNA, but the **structured output layer**
- The "B mode" concept: a single keystroke in any LLM interface that generates the TACTIK READOUT of that conversation
- Google brief = the new category; the briefs hub = the organizational structure; TACTIK Lens = the Google surface capture tool

**What was built:**
- `brief/google/index.html` — Google Ecosystem brief (new category, full architecture)
- `briefs/index.html` — Brief hub with 5 categories
- `tools/lens/index.html` — TACTIK Lens Chrome extension packager
- `SANTIAGO-DNA.md` — This file (operator model, persistent)
- `.claude/commands/brief.md` — The `/brief` skill

**What didn't change:**
- Lovable project (zero risk to production)
- The debrief API endpoint (already live)
- The Tactik Debrief GPT configuration

**Key insight from this session:**
> "El sistema de Brief es lo que tiene IP. No la simulación. El output estructurado — que sirve para contexto, para resúmenes, para que el usuario pueda recurrir, devolver, asistir, usar más tokens. El 'B mode' no es un producto nuevo. Es una tecla."

**Open questions carried forward:**
- How does `/brief` persist to the Supabase `belief_events` ledger (not just this file)?
- What does the Anthropic partnership brief look like? (equivalent of `brief/google/`)
- Can the `generate_brief(person, context)` MCP tool be built this week?
